thread:
Maya (product): Quick sync request — multizone fallback sequencing and priority lanes. Customers B and C pushed for region-pin and strict fallback contracts. What's negotiable?
Alex (infra): We should define launch gates: 1) per-tenant SLA contracts signed, 2) fallback routes verified under load, 3) rollback automation and canary thresholds.
Diego (eng-arch): From runtime side: strict pinning means no fallback -> higher cost/less resilience. Fallbacks add ~40-80ms tail variance depending on KV-cache hits. Can we map guarantees to product tiers? :thinking_face:
Priya (pm): Customers are willing to pay for Dedicated for guarantees. For hosted/free tiers we propose "best-effort" fallback. Need clear messaging in sales docs.
Sam (sre): Ops asks: evacuation playbook + auto-quarantine flag. We need SLOs, alert thresholds, and a test harness for tenant evacuation drills.
Diego (eng-arch): quick policy sketch:
```
policy shard: region-primary
fallback: [region-secondary, edge-fallback]
priority: [dedicated, reserved, hosted]
quarantine_threshold: 95pct_cpu
```
Maya (product): Nice sketch — keep DSL minimal. Also add customer-negotiable fields: latency_budget, allowed_fallbacks, billing_penalty.
Alex (infra): Implementation notes: cross-region preferrers require routing table updates + capacity reservation. We'll need a migration plan to avoid noisy neighbor impact. Can we standardize a "soft-pin" that prefers region but allows fallback after Xs?
Priya (pm): Proposal: soft-pin for hosted (failover after 3s), strict-pin for Dedicated (no failover unless manual). Sales can include strict-pin in Dedicated contracts.
Maya (product): Launch gates checklist draft: signed contract (if strict-pin), performance test pass (load + failover), playbook + runbook, customer acceptance test. Anything missing?
Sam (sre): Add chaos drill in staging and a monitoring dashboard: failover-rate, p99 tail, eviction-count, quarantine-events.
deploy-bot: new doc uploaded — https://redwood.share/doc/multizone-fallback-plan (uploaded by Alex)
Maya (product): Let's sync Thurs 11am to finalize launch criteria and list negotiables. @Alex @Diego @Priya @Sam :thumbsup:
Alex (infra): +1
Diego (eng-arch): 👍
Priya (pm): 👍
Sam (sre): will add runbook PR before sync :white_check_mark:
